news_intelligence.title: Vedanta lines up $25 bn investment over next three years for organic growth
news_intelligence.summary:
The Vedanta Group has lined up USD 25 billion in investments over the next three years to expand capacities across its existing businesses through organic growth and brownfield expansions, a top company official said. Vedanta founder and chairman Anil Agarwal, who was in the city on Wednesday, said the conglomerate would focus on its existing assets for growth, while remaining open to acquiring public sector assets if opportunities arise. "Current capex plans are for organic growth in aluminium, copper, zinc, oil and gas. All will be brownfield expansions," he said. "We are going to invest around USD 25 billion," Agarwal said. The capital expenditure would also support Vedanta's ambition to become one of the world's largest mining companies in critical metals, and emerge as a leading silver producer within three to four years, he said. The group, which comprises 10 major companies, aims to grow its overall business from USD 30 billion to USD 50 billion within three years, Agarwal

news_intelligence.title: Asian Paints Q2FY27 result: Profit rises 7.5% to ₹1,068 cr, sales grow 17%
news_intelligence.summary:
Asian Paints Ltd on Thursday reported a 7.5 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit at Rs 1,067.6 crore for the September quarter, as strong sales growth across domestic coatings and international markets was partly offset by rising raw material costs and pressure on operating margins. Consolidated net sales rose 16.9 per cent to Rs 9,953.9 crore in the quarter ended September 30, while profit before depreciation, interest, tax and other income (PBDIT) increased 3.6 per cent to Rs 1,557.1 crore, the country's largest paintmaker said in a statement. The PBDIT margin contracted to 15.6 per cent from 17.7 per cent a year earlier, reflecting the impact of sharp raw material inflation and supply constraints linked to geopolitical disruptions. The company said it absorbed part of the cost increases to protect consumer demand while implementing calibrated price hikes.
